criteria.requirement: Activating it must hide the menu and open a new local module without calling `joinGameUrl`, creating a connector, or making any network request.
criteria.action: Load the main page offline, click Animation Lab, and monitor connector construction and network requests.
criteria.expected: The lab scene and controls appear, the menu is hidden, and no game connector or network request is created. (Tolerance: No connector calls and no network requests; Back to menu restores the original menu.)

criteria.requirement: Create a hierarchy named `actor`, `torso`, `head`, `upperArmL`, `upperArmR`, and `ball`; also store each name in `userData.nodeId`.
criteria.action: Inspect the live scene graph, geometry parameters, and initial local transforms after opening the lab.
criteria.expected: All six named nodes exist with the specified parentage, dimensions, positions, and matching userData.nodeId values. (Tolerance: 1e-6 for positions and dimensions; exact names and parentage.)

criteria.requirement: Thus at `t=1.5`, root Y is `0.125`, left X rotation is `-30` degrees, and right X rotation is `30` degrees.
criteria.action: Call window.animationLab.sampleClip(1.5) and inspect the three animated local channels.
criteria.expected: actor.position.y is 0.125, upperArmL.rotation.x is -pi/6, and upperArmR.rotation.x is pi/6. (Tolerance: 1e-6 in scene units and radians.)

criteria.requirement: Step is allowed only while paused and advances exactly `1/120` seconds, wrapping modulo `4`.
criteria.action: Pause at time zero, invoke Step once, then set paused time to 4-1/240 and invoke Step again.
criteria.expected: The first step produces 1/120; the second advances by 1/120 and wraps to 1/240, with the corresponding sampled pose. (Tolerance: 1e-9 seconds internally and 1e-6 for transforms.)

criteria.requirement: Empty, nonnumeric, NaN, infinite, or out-of-range input must leave time, pose, speed, and play state unchanged and display `Invalid time` in a dedicated status element.
criteria.action: Snapshot state, submit each invalid value, and compare time, transforms, speed, play state, and status text.
criteria.expected: Every invalid submission preserves the complete prior state and displays exactly Invalid time. (Tolerance: Exact state equality except floating-point transforms within 1e-9.)

criteria.requirement: Generate exactly `121` samples for `i=0..120`, each `{ "time": i/30, "actorY": ..., "leftArmXDeg": ..., "rightArmXDeg": ... }`, sampling independently without changing current playback state or time.
criteria.action: Set a nonzero paused pose, export samples, parse the textarea JSON, and compare state before and after.
criteria.expected: Duration is 4, sampleRate is 30, 121 ordered samples end at time 4 with zero-valued channels, and current state is unchanged. (Tolerance: Exported numeric values rounded to six decimal places; exact sample count and schema.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
